answer: Like deep mycelium funneling nutrients across an underground horizon, our network routes trust through cryptographic stake-weighted transitive endorsements. To amplify a fraudulent signal, an adversary cannot merely spin up cheap identities; validating each clustered clone imposes a superlinear cost through quadratic bond penalties. As pure mycelial conduits filter out toxic copper impurities, decentralized consensus crystallizes only resilient nodes, making large-scale forgery exponentially ruinous.
